section: Dean's conjecture (cycles of length divisible by k)
title: Dean's conjecture: minimum degree k+1 gives a cycle of length 2 mod k
summary: Lean: minimum degree >= k+1 gives a cycle of length = 2 (mod k), and minimum degree >= k gives a cycle of length >= k+1. Known; the open case k = 5 needs block/ear structure not in Mathlib.
notes: DeanSmall.exists_cycle_mod_two, exists_cycle_mod_two_five, exists_cycle_length_ge (formal-conjectures definitions). Status: known for k != 5 (Chen-Saito, Dean-Lesniak-Saito, Luo-Ma-Zhao 2026); every natural weaker k = 5 form is published. Outside Lean: none for the stated theorems.

title: Casas-Alvero conjecture for degrees 2 to 6 in Lean
summary: Over any field of characteristic 0, a monic polynomial of degree d <= 6 sharing a factor with each of its Hasse derivatives of order < d is (X - a)^d; explicit resultant certificates checked by linear_combination.
notes: CasasAlveroSmall.casas_alvero_deg_2..5 (casas_alvero_mathlib.lean), casas_alvero_deg_6 (casas_alvero6_mathlib.lean, 794 KB, 16-case split on factored resultants). Statement as in formal-conjectures with the degree fixed. Known for d = p^k, 2p^k, 5p^e, 12; smallest open degree 20. Outside Lean: none for the stated theorems.

sources.cite: Graf v. Bothmer-Labs-Schicho-van de Woestijne 2007; Draisma-de Jong; Castryck-Laterveer-Ounaies, Math. Comp. 2014

prior_art.note: No Lean proof of any degree found before this.
